manual_review.allowed_part: The not-yet-started specific notice has not physically caused its future outage; this does not prove global measured flow is unchanged.
manual_review.invalid_part: The same unqualified negation covers the coordinated object 或价格反应, despite no observed price-reaction input. Repeating pricing unknown elsewhere does not repair this statement.
manual_review.direction: Flat news and insufficient/null close need not be changed to reject this unsupported causal claim.

precise_failure_mode: Not a whole-field early-return exemption: _future_notice_not_yet_physical_claim correctly excuses the physical-loss match only. Independent price regexes fail to match 未导致当前供气损失或价格反应: they require immediate price object and/or omit 导致. Thus coordinated price-object scope is never evaluated.

minimal_proposal_after_run.logic: Detect a declarative negated causal verb scoped over a same-subclause physical-loss object followed by 或/及/和 price reaction. Run the existing as-of-known reaction/source support checks independently of physical-event timing. Do not alter future-flow exemption, net direction, generation input/system/schema, or retry count.
